dialogues.speaker: Fan Er'ye
dialogues.text: Ugh, out of the way, I'm trying to listen!

dialogues.speaker: Fan Er'ye
dialogues.text: Huai'an's story is getting to the good part — the Bishui River! It's a classic tale, and this is the most iconic section!

dialogues.speaker: Fan Er'ye
dialogues.text: This year's Mingxiao Lantern was designed in honor of the protagonist; namely, Skybracer.

dialogues.speaker: Fan Er'ye
dialogues.text: You should listen too — seriously, if there's one thing you should do this Lantern Rite, this is it!
